topic: SAML users keep losing admin role
symptom_pattern: Admins who were manually granted the Admin role lose it every time they log in via SAML and end up as Standard users.
root_cause: AuthN mappings are enabled, so roles are recomputed from IdP attributes at every login; the users' group attribute doesn't map to Admin, overriding manual assignments.
resolution_path: Check whether role mappings are enabled and what attributes the users send
Map the IdP group to the Admin role (or adjust the IdP)
Have the user log in again and confirm the role

qa_pairs.tse_question: Are Role Mappings enabled in Organization Settings?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Yes, our IdP team turned them on last month.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Which groups does the affected user's assertion contain?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: Only 'eng-all'; the admin group isn't sent.

customer_style.tone: org admin, escalating internally, wants it fixed today
